name: Swiftfin Enhanced
subtitle: Swiftfin with real-time Apple GPU enhancement
description: An unofficial personal Swiftfin fork that follows Jellyfin upstream and adds a thermally adaptive iOS/iPadOS Enhanced player with Apple MetalFX scaling, source-FPS frame pacing, customizable text-subtitle positioning, and a background-safe playback sleep timer. Builds are produced automatically from public source code.

apps.name: Swiftfin Enhanced
apps.subtitle: Jellyfin playback with Apple MetalFX enhancement
apps.localizedDescription: An unofficial build of Swiftfin for iPhone and iPad. It retains Swiftfin's Jellyfin experience and adds an optional AVPlayer-based Apple MetalFX enhancement pipeline with realtime edge-quality profiles, duplicate-render and offscreen-fill suppression, source-FPS frame pacing, bounded processing buffering, automatic thermal and frame-budget throttling, PiP resource suspension, customizable text-subtitle size and black-bar positioning, A/B comparison, a performance monitor, and a background-safe playback sleep timer.
